phase: 9 -- owned data first: every Atlas-owned artifact that could already know Portland, measured before new acquisition
headline: Every committed market graph was scanned for a node in this market's 70 admitted postal codes (count below). Portland is the first Oregon market and the one Pacific Northwest graph (seattle-wa) ends north of Longview: owned identities and owned policy are measured, not assumed.
a_brand_prefix_is_not_a_market: Marriott's PDX prefix covers the whole metro -- and Salem, Newberg and Vancouver, Washington -- and never decides membership; Portland, MAINE is PWM and never selected. A route carries no postal code, so every route is a LEAD with a PRESUMED disposition read off the brand's own slug.

live_identity_names.what_it_is: The normalised canonical name of every identity every registered market publishes. No live market has Oregon or Vancouver premises, so a Portland row can collide with a live market ONLY by name; the census holds any Portland row whose own normalised name is already published elsewhere.

cross_market_name_collision_guard.what_this_order_does_about_it: MEASURES it and hands the strings to the census reconciliation as a named guard, which HOLDS rather than silently drops any hit. This order does NOT edit the shared exclusion file.

provider_history.pay_once_rule: Every URL this order is about to buy is checked against these ledgers first.
provider_history.refusals_are_treated_as_stale: A prior refusal ages in days and is re-probed, never inherited.

owned_osm_extract: WASHINGTON OWNED (the Seattle order's washington-261002, reused byte-for-byte for Vancouver / Clark County); OREGON NOT OWNED -- this order downloaded Geofabrik oregon-261002 once, free (see the OSM lane).
what_is_never_reused: Membership (re-decided here) and pet policy (none exists to import: every prior node in these codes was OUTSIDE its own market and unverified).
